structure_changes: Four inward-opening rigid output-bearing cups integrate their outer shoulders. Remove four caps, cap bolt/nut pairs, tall screw tabs and obsolete cap coupon. Bearings and gear centres retain their positions.

Four purchased HIROSUGI F3035-5105T flanged steel spacers limit inward bearing withdrawal through the inner rings. One-piece carrier ends add1.5mm-thick broad flanges; retain original clamp section elsewhere and open fastener reliefs fully to remove thin slivers.

Two separate horn backstraps are removed. Enlarge only the bought horn tip holes from nominal1.0 to1.8mm; share existing M1.6x8/DIN934 hardware with servo ears. Single adapter uses2mm screw clearance and smaller outer end while retaining minimum1.544mm pocket wall.
Paired servo/input-drive module remains removable. Shaft lengths, gears, optical mounts, rail and equipment placements remain unchanged.
validation_changes: Bearing capture checks actual integral outer shoulder, spacer inner-ring contact, full360degree guide walls, complete bearing support through bounded inward travel, and carrier/frame stop chain. Missing spacer, flipped spacer, missing shoulder or guide sector and excessive endplay are rejected.

Ordered service checks output gear removal, shaft retraction6.5mm, spacer staging0.3mm, complete rotor lateral extraction40mm, full shaft withdrawal and inward bearing/spacer removal against retained obstacles.

Full rotation plus measured axial travel checks complete motor/carrier/propeller/shaft/clamp assembly against frame and fixed mounting hardware. Through-horn joint checks actual head-on-metal and nut-on-adapter seating and ordered screw/nut service.
Complete old/new native shape, placement, control, registry and procurement audit, followed by regenerated release artifacts and regression checks.
mass_scope: Common-assumption CAD volume/density comparison, not measured or all-up mass. Other equipment and unmodeled hardware exclusions remain explicit in the generated mass budget.

native_regression.note: Complete native suite passed before final explanatory BOM/metrics wording changes; 7 native procurement tests and all final saved-CAD release checks passed afterward.

release_verification.qualification_limit: Geometry, nominal motion, service paths and artifact identity only; received bearing/spacer fit, prepared horn strength, actual grip and PA12 creep remain physical checks.
